citation.title: Model-based electron density estimation using multiple diagnostics on TCV
citation.authors: F. Pastore, F. Felici, T.O.S.J. Bosman, C. Galperti, O. Sauter, B. Vincent, N.M.T. Vu, and the TCV team

scope_read.limitations: Figures were read only as rendered. Details of the RAPDENS model and the Kalman-gain tuning are deferred to cited works [15,26].

claim_checks.proposed_claim: The observer and Thomson rates are 1 kHz and 60 Hz.
claim_checks.source_finding: The interferometer (FIR) is sampled at 20 kHz, and Thomson scattering (TS) provides up to 117 points at up to 60 Hz. For the TCV shot, FIR is subsampled at 1 kHz, as on one TCV control node, and one in three TS samples is discarded because of a noisier laser. The paper never states the observer's own update or computation rate.
claim_checks.locator: p.3 Sec.3.1; p.6 Sec.5 and Fig.7
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: On TCV, a model-based Kalman observer fused interferometry, subsampled at 1 kHz, with Thomson scattering available at up to 60 Hz to estimate the electron density profile.
claim_checks.qualification: 60 Hz is the TS maximum; the effective TS rate used in the shot analysis was lower. 1 kHz is the FIR input rate, not a measured observer latency.

claim_checks.source_finding: The shot analysis is an offline replay using signals identical to those in the TCV real-time system. The authors state the results are representative of real-time performance. Real-time use and analysis across many discharges are listed as future work. Earlier real-time RAPDENS use is attributed to [18], not demonstrated here.
claim_checks.locator: p.6 Sec.5; p.8 Sec.6; p.2 Sec.1
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: The multi-rate reconstruction was evaluated offline on synthetic data and on one TCV discharge, using inputs matching the real-time control system.
claim_checks.qualification: Do not describe this as a real-time deployment or as a timing demonstration.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: The estimated quantity is the electron density profile.
claim_checks.source_finding: The state is the B-spline coefficients of the flux-surface-averaged electron density n_e(rho,t), plus vessel and wall particle inventories (and optional disturbances). Synthetic TS and FIR measurements are produced via a time-varying mapping H_k built from LIUQE equilibria. A per-chord FIR scale factor kappa, computed from the last TS-updated state, corrects FIR offsets between TS samples.
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Model-based observers have combined fast line-integrated and slow local density measurements, using the slow diagnostic to recalibrate the fast one between samples.
claim_checks.qualification: The quantity is electron density, not CES ion or impurity temperature. TS serves as a filter input, not a held-out target.

input_target_timing.inputs: Real FIR line integrals (subsampled to 1 kHz, fringe-jump corrected), real TS local n_e, gas-valve flux, LIUQE magnetics-only equilibrium, and an L-H state flag from a real-time detector.
input_target_timing.outputs: n_e(rho,t) spline profile and synthetic FIR/TS predictions.
input_target_timing.causal_or_offline: The filter is causal (recursive EKF using current and past measurements) but was run offline.
input_target_timing.source_diagnostic_as_input: Yes. TS and FIR are both inputs, and TS is also the comparison reference.
input_target_timing.reported_vs_physical_truth: The authors assume TS gives correct local values (Raman-calibrated). Agreement is with TS, not with independent truth.

validation.split_unit: not_applicable: one synthetic scenario plus one discharge (#73631); no train/test split.
validation.independent_truth: Only in the synthetic test, which used fixed circular geometry and imposed FIR offsets (Sec.4, Figs.3-5). None in the shot analysis.
validation.unknowns: No quantitative error metrics or uncertainty intervals. Covariances were hand-tuned on the same shot (Eqs.19-22). Generalization to other discharges is untested.

runtime_or_deployment.what_not_established: Latency, real-time execution in this work, and multi-shot robustness.

forbidden_inferences: 1 kHz is a measured observer runtime
The method estimates temperature or impurity quantities
Kappa smoothing was implemented (it is only suggested)
competing_or_complementary: Complementary. It fuses slow local and fast integrated measurements, with a transport model, to estimate the current density state. We instead nowcast the slow CES report from fast BES/ECEI snapshots and past reports, without a transport model.
